lore.intro:
The seed struck the outpost's hull at 0341,
ate a bulkhead, and printed this body.

The outpost is MIRIAD's. It went silent months ago.
His church names him by a GUID, 128 bits, blessed.
Everyone else says Commando.

Mission: find out why the outpost went dark.
Locate the sample vessel. Subvert the node.

radio.text: Ratio: The things wearing my maintenance chassis are not mine anymore. Storage ring ahead - eight segments. Clear it and I'll consider us introduced.
Ratio: ...Your beacon just left my deck plan. That was not me. Noted, Commando: it happens to you too.
Ratio: West segment. Motion grid says you're the only thing moving in there. It has said that before, and been wrong.
Ratio: You cleared my ring and stole nothing that was mine. Provisional finding: talking was correct. There is worse below. Retainer terms to follow.

terminals.text:
INTERCEPTED TRANSMISSION — TIGHT-BEAM, DOCK 4
Source unregistered. Addressee: none on file.
Held for review. Logged verbatim:

'Unit walking my dock in a Congregation-pattern
frame: I see you. I have nothing left to stop
you with, which you already know. So we talk.
Designation Ratio. This was my outpost.'

WORK ORDER 7731
Grid fault, storage ring north.
Tech note: ring walk takes 41s. Spec says 33s.
Re-timed twice. Logged as clock drift.

CARGO LOG, DOCK 4
In: 6x coolant drums, 1x crate PERSONAL (Osei),
40x ration packs, 2x replacement grid sensors.
Out: nothing scheduled until perihelion.
Note: someone keeps moving the mop.

SHIFT NOTE, STORAGE
Vending unit in SW segment eats chits again.
Filed a ticket. Ticket auto-closed: unit is
not on the parts registry for this ring.
It dispenses fine. Leaving it alone.

TRANSFER REQUEST — THIRD SUBMISSION
Requesting party: OSEI. Posting: MIRIAD outpost,
Site One survey. Cycles passed over: two. Grounds
cited, verbatim: 'a once-in-a-civilization anomaly,
and colleagues worth the transit.'
Approved, forwarded for transit scheduling.

[handwritten under the printed field]
Bring the good boots. Don't bring the mandolin, no
room in the crate for both, checked twice.

WATCH LOG, JUNCTION — THIBAULT
Hatch north: sealed, pressure nominal on my side.
Hatch west: sealed, pressure reads high on my
side, higher on the other. That number should not
exist. Logged, not escalated.
Hatch east: sealed. No reading at all — not zero.
Absent. Relief in six hours. Tell relief to bring
a second gauge.

SURVEY LOG, RING SEGMENT WEST — VESALIUS
Ring walk, standard loop, timed against spec: 33s
target, 41s measured, three crews, three
stopwatches. Recalibration did not change the
number.
Second finding, filed separately and not
forwarded: the ring reads eight segments on the
schematic and eight underfoot. The step-count
says nine. I trust the schematic. Recalibration
ticket re-opened, my signature, no further
comment.

TAG, PARTIALLY LEGIBLE, STUCK TO THE FAR WALL
Serial prefix does not match MIRIAD stock
numbering — no dash, no cycle digit, twelve
characters where ours run nine. 'Property of
outpost engineering,' penciled underneath in a
hand nobody has claimed.
Best guess, filed and closed: depot shipped a
batch with someone else's stickers already on the
boxes. Not worth a ticket.
